title: The Handling Charge Kept from an Air Ticket Fare Brands Tax Return for a Club Member
content:
A traveller's standing in the Wanderlane Traveller Club bears on the handling charge kept from the sum returned when carrier-imposed taxes are paid back on an Air Ticket Fare Brands booking. Two readings of the membership decide it: whether the club tier waives the agency service fee, and how many qualifying accruals the membership has posted over the last 12 months.

## 1. The charge

1.1 Where the traveller's club tier waives the agency service fee and the membership has posted 3 or more qualifying accruals over the last 12 months, no handling charge is kept: the charge stands at 0.00 USD.

1.2 Where the traveller's club tier does not waive the agency service fee and the membership has posted 3 or more qualifying accruals over the last 12 months, the member handling charge of 12.00 USD is kept.

1.3 In every other case no such treatment applies to the charge.

## 2. What the accrual count is read from

The accruals counted are the qualifying entries standing in the membership's own points ledger inside the last 12 months. The fee waiver is a property of the club tier held.

## 3. The two readings set side by side

| Club tier waives the agency service fee | Qualifying accruals over the last 12 months | Handling charge |
| --- | --- | --- |
| yes | 3 or more | 0.00 USD |
| yes | fewer than 3 | no such treatment |
| no | 3 or more | 12.00 USD |
| no | fewer than 3 | no such treatment |

The count is of accrual entries, not of points: a membership with two very large accruals inside the window has posted 2, not 3, and falls outside both of the first two rows.

## 4. Hypothetical readings

A membership at a tier that waives the agency service fee, with 5 qualifying accruals posted inside the window, keeps no handling charge at all.

A membership at a tier that does not waive that fee, with 4 qualifying accruals inside the window, keeps the member charge of 12.00 USD.

A membership at a tier that waives the fee but with only 1 qualifying accrual inside the window meets neither of the first two conditions, and no such treatment applies.
